Clara M: dropping a quick pass on the policies editor after yesterday's usability test. uploaded screen record + notes: https://fig.redwood/policies-1812500000 :mag:

Clara M: main issues I saw:
- collapsed rules look like cards not a sequence; users thought order didn't matter
- no discoverable keyboard reorder (tab stops skip the handle)
- error banner says 'rules invalid' with a tiny X, no link to which rule failed
- preview mode doesn't show evaluation trace, only final route name

Evan K: for keyboard reorder I can add small visible "↑ / ↓" buttons that appear on focus (not hover) and are reachable by tab. Should we also support a long-press drag for touch?

Rae P: yes to visible controls. Accessibility checklist:
- each control has aria-label like "Move Rule 4 up"
- announce reorder completion via aria-live polite: "Rule 4 moved to position 2"
- ensure badge contrast >= 4.5:1 for AA

Ilya B: on validation copy: users get overwhelmed with a generic banner. Proposal:
- inline validation on each row with a subtle red pill: "Syntax error: missing quote" and a link "Fix"
- aggregate banner only for bulk failures: "5 rules failed validation. Review rules." (button opens filter view)

Clara M: preview improvements suggestion: show a compact evaluation trace above the result: "Evaluated: Rule 1 (no match), Rule 2 (runtime error), Rule 3 matched (pattern 'beta')". each item can expand to show the condition and the simulated request values that were used.

Evan K: implementation note: we'll need stable rule IDs and include them in the preview response. payload example: `{
  preview_id: 123,
  evaluated: [{rule_id: "r-45", outcome: "no_match"}, {rule_id: "r-62", outcome: "matched", reason: "header X-Env=beta"}]
}`

Rae P: small UI thing: when rules are collapsed, add a faint vertical guide line and a numeric badge so screen reader + visual users can infer priority. Also ensure the badges are in the DOM order matching priority for SR navigation.

Clara M: microcopy options for preview pill:
- primary: "Matched by Rule 3 — view details"
- tooltip: "Opens rule and highlights the matching clause and values"

Ilya B: analytics: track preview_open, preview_expand_rule (rule_id), rule_reorder (from,to), validation_ignored. helps us see where people get stuck.

CIbot: snapshot 1812500000-ux-uploaded to Figma: https://fig.redwood/policies-1812500000/shot :white_check_mark:

Clara M: next: Evan to ship keyboard move buttons + API change for preview ids (ETA Thu), Rae to write a11y acceptance criteria, Ilya to add telemetry events. I'll post a short QA script tomorrow. thanks :sparkles:
